one_sentence: Wavefunction collapse and the Fall of Genesis 3 share a five-property structural isomorphism, not merely analogy.
executive_summary: This document establishes a five-property structural isomorphism between quantum wavefunction collapse and the Fall described in Genesis 3. The mapping is instantaneous, irreversible, non-local, regime-changing, and involves information gain at the cost of freedom. Each property of collapse has a precise counterpart in the Fall narrative, supported by biblical text and quantum mechanics. The isomorphism passes separability, reducibility, constraint, and bidirectionality tests, confirming structural coupling rather than loose analogy. The conclusion is that both events are manifestations of the same substrate operating at different scales—physical and moral.
short_summary: This document is a formal isomorphism paper mapping wavefunction collapse to the Fall of Genesis 3. The core structural claim is that five properties of collapse (instantaneous, irreversible, non-local, regime-changing, information-gaining) map one-to-one onto five properties of the Fall. Key evidence includes biblical verses (Genesis 3:7, 3:24) and quantum mechanics principles (Bell's theorem, measurement problem). This matters because it provides a rigorous structural link between physics and theology, with falsifiable predictions and bidirectional consequences.
